scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-barbados in the 1815 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1815.geojson; file SHA256 fb654f734583f550904cfa45f361e395c1a488c4960050da2632cb2ac7d1cd1e; geometry SHA256 449ae920358e6d5c6794f5bf3ffe59a0218c95a2faab462bb5e598054424f6a6; map IDs entity-barbados
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 447.938112802608 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
